verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's own API documents Ted transfers (a Brazilian domestic wire) and Pix for both sending and receiving, so part of the story is met: domestic wires plus a fast rail through one API. The evidence never mentions RTP or FedNow, the US instant rails the story names, and it does not document capabilities rail by rail. missing for 10: RTP origination/receipt, FedNow origination/receipt, documented inbound wire receipt, per-rail capability documentation, independent corroboration.
